newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends steady vs dollar in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends steady vs dollar in dull trade.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended Monday little changed at 35.82/83 per dollar in thin, lacklustre trade, dealers said.
They said the rupee traded in a narrow range between 35.83 and 35.84 per dollar on Tuesday.
"The market seems to be already in holiday mode," said a dealer. "There was little trade today..dollar supplies remain good and the anticipated year-end demand is yet to be felt."
Dealers said the rupee remained steady against the forward dollar, ending marginally down in dull trade.
The premia for six-month dollars ended Monday at an annualised 7.76 percent against the weekend close of 7.82 percent, dealers said.
